description.zh: 在一串实物组中补出空缺那一组应有的数量。训练的是具体数量关系的规律识别：多少交替、每次多/少同样的数量、以及三种数量的循环。界面不出现阿拉伯数字，数量只以实物呈现。
description.en: Fill in how many objects belong in the missing group of a strip. What it trains is recognising rules over concrete quantities: more/fewer alternation, adding or removing the same amount each step, and a three-amount cycle. No numerals appear on screen; quantities are shown only as objects.

designModel.zh: 主轴是变化规则（alternate → monotonic → cycle），monotonic 内部再按步长（一个 → 两个）与数量范围（≤5 → ≤9）加深，空格位置从末尾放开到任意。
designModel.en: The primary axis is the change rule (alternate, then monotonic, then cycle); within monotonic, depth comes from step size (one, then two) and count range (up to 5, then up to 9), and the gap moves from the end to anywhere.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 只用 1-3 个物体的交替，适合 3-4 岁；G1 两个两个变、最多 9 个物体，约 6 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1 uses only 1-3 objects in alternation, suited to ages 3-4; G1's steps of two with up to 9 objects suit about age 6.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列。与 learning/math/number-sense 共享数量感，但 number-sense 教数与量的对应；本模块不教数数，只练在数量通道上识别变化规则。与 number-pattern 的区别：后者用阿拉伯数字做运算规律，本模块只用实物。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds. It shares quantity sense with learning/math/number-sense, but number-sense teaches the number-quantity correspondence; this module does not teach counting, it drills change rules on the quantity channel. Unlike number-pattern, which works with numerals and arithmetic rules, this module uses objects only.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: alternate 两种数量轮流；monotonic 每步多或少同样的数量；cycle 三种不同数量按顺序循环。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: alternate takes turns between two amounts; monotonic adds or removes the same amount each step; cycle repeats three distinct amounts in order.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 只对 monotonic 有意义：one 每次变一个，two 每次变两个；alternate 与 cycle 记为 none。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: Only meaningful for monotonic: one changes by one each step, two by two; alternate and cycle are recorded as none.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 题目中（含选项）出现的最大数量：small ≤3，medium ≤5 或 ≤6，large ≤9。物体按每行 3 个排列，便于一眼看出数量。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: The largest count shown in the item, options included: small up to 3, medium up to 5 or 6, large up to 9. Objects are laid out three per row so a count can be seen at a glance.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: end 是『下一组有多少』；any 空格可能在开头或中间。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: end asks how many come next; any may put the gap at the start or middle.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: K1 给 3 个选项，之后都是 4 个。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: K1 offers three options; later grades offer four.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 6 题，通过线 75%（5/6）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Six items per run, passing at 75% (5/6). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 1-3 个物体的两种数量轮流出现，补出下一组。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two amounts of 1-3 objects take turns; fill in the next group.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 每次多一个或少一个（最多 5 个），补出下一组。
levelMap.objectiveEn: One more or one fewer each time (up to 5); fill in the next group.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 每次多两个或少两个（最多 9 个），空格可能在中间，排除『只变一个』的干扰。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two more or two fewer each time (up to 9), with the gap possibly mid-strip; reject the 'changed by one' distractor.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三种数量按顺序循环（最多 6 个），在任意位置补出缺失的一组。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three amounts repeat in order (up to 6); fill a missing group anywhere in the strip.

statistics.noteZh: monotonic 的 optionTypes 区分 unchanged_step（照抄前一组）、too_far（多走一步）与 step_misread（按 1 而不是按步长变化），能看出是方向、步数还是步长没读对。
statistics.noteEn: For monotonic items, optionTypes separate unchanged_step (copied the previous group), too_far (one step too many) and step_misread (changed by one instead of by the step), showing whether direction, position or step size was misread.
